explain.API-E-CONSOLIDATION-COST: consolidation1d exceeds MAX_CONSOLIDATION_COST = 500000000 (Σ intervals n³ + Σ substeps n², n free nodes: elements for single drainage, elements−1 for double drainage), MAX_CONSOLIDATION_SEGMENTS = 256, or MAX_CONSOLIDATION_SUBSTEPS = 100000. Intervals join load breakpoints and output times across the entire history, including after the last output; each contributes max(1, ceil(interval/max_step_s)) substeps. Saturating u128 arithmetic, without deducting reused factors. Rejected during validation with invalid / exit 2; reduce the history/mesh/outputs or increase max_step_s. Budget calibrated in release mode with a target of ≤5 s, without a deadline guarantee on other machines; see docs/METHODS_GUIDE.md and provenance/ENG-SFC-010.md, r3.
explain.API-E-CONSOLIDATION-WORK: consolidation1d exceeds MAX_CONSOLIDATION_WORK = 50000000: the sum of substeps across the entire history, split at load breakpoints and output times, multiplied by the total element count. Reduce the history/mesh or increase max_step_s. Rejected during validation, before integration; see docs/METHODS_GUIDE.md.
explain.API-E-INPUT: Invalid JSON or engine-input/1 structure. Check fields, types, and member load references. nonlinearStatic, soilProfile, and consolidation1d are Experimental pending ENG-VAL-006: they require options.allow_experimental = true at the job root.
explain.API-E-SFC-OPTIONS: SFC-010: nonlinearStatic, soilProfile, and consolidation1d are Experimental pending ENG-VAL-006 coverage (Jonathan's decision via J0 2026-10-20); they require options.allow_experimental = true at the job root. Check compatibility between method, spring, law, Winkler, and releases. Physical parameters and soil provenance are explicit; see docs/METHODS_GUIDE.md.
explain.API-I-CANCELLED: Cooperative cancellation requested between stages, before combine/factorize for each consolidation interval, between blocks of up to 16 columns in its reference factorization, or before each substep. Partial responses are not emitted.
explain.API-W-COMBINED-PRESCRIBED: Follow-up #85: prescribed displacements in a combination are the sum of factor·δ, including a single weighted settlement. Check the explicit factor; multiple nonzero settlement cases are rejected.
explain.API-W-DIAPHRAGM-RECOVERY: Follow-up #84: recovery with diaphragms lacks domain test coverage. Check equilibrium and results before using them.
explain.API-W-MASS-PROJECTION: #86: load-to-mass conversion rejects any negative projection, without tolerance; gravity not aligned with the axes may cause rejection due to rounding.
explain.API-W-PDELTA-INERTIA: #78: LDLᵀ inertia with 2×2 blocks uses copysign without a confirmed test; review the stability diagnostic.
explain.ENG-E-0001: The input uses a unit the engine does not recognize. Check its name and convert the quantity to a supported unit.
explain.ENG-E-0002: Two entities of the same class share an identifier. Assign unique identifiers and update the corresponding references.
explain.ENG-E-0003: A relationship points to an entity missing from the model. Check the identifier and create the required entity or correct the reference.
explain.ENG-E-0004: The node is isolated from the model members. Check connectivity and connect the node or remove the entity that does not participate in the calculation.
explain.ENG-E-0005: The member ends coincide and do not define a usable length. Check the coordinates and references to its end nodes.
explain.ENG-E-0006: The equations do not determine a unique solution. Check supports, connectivity, releases, and stiffness for unresisted movement.
explain.ENG-E-0007: The procedure exhausted its steps without meeting the tolerances. Check the data, tolerances, and calculation increment sizes.
explain.ENG-E-0008: An undefined or infinite value was received. Check conversions, prior operations, and original data before starting the calculation.
explain.ENG-E-0009: The parties require contracts with different names or major versions. Use components that share both values; the minor version does not affect this check.
explain.ENG-E-0010: The operation received an unsupported dimension or one incompatible with the model. Check whether the model is planar or spatial and adapt the data to that dimension.
explain.ENG-E-0011: The component or its global position is outside the available set. Check the model dimension and degree of freedom numbering.
explain.ENG-E-0012: An internal condition prevents completion of the operation. Keep the input data and diagnostic code to reproduce the situation and investigate its cause.
explain.ENG-E-0013: The input is valid, but the component does not implement the requested capability (for example, evaluating geometric stiffness in a state other than the reference state). Use a component that supports it or limit the request to supported operations; do not retry with the same data.
explain.ENG-E-0014: Guyan condensation requires positive definite Kss. A singular pivot or a negative stiffness direction prevents recovery of the massless DOFs. Check supports, connectivity, and releases at the specified node/DOF; no artificial mass or stiffness is added.
